name: live_view, installing Elixir
expected:
sh <(curl 'https://ash-hq.org/install/jose_valim_is_my_hero?install=phoenix') \
    && cd jose_valim_is_my_hero && mix igniter.install ash ash_phoenix \
    ash_postgres ash_authentication ash_authentication_phoenix ash_admin \
    live_debugger --auth-strategy magic_link --setup --yes

name: live_view, Elixir already installed
expected:
mix archive.install hex igniter_new --force
mix archive.install hex phx_new 1.8.15 --force

mix igniter.new jose_valim_is_my_hero --with phx.new \
  --install ash,ash_phoenix --install ash_postgres,ash_authentication \
  --install ash_authentication_phoenix,ash_admin --install live_debugger \
  --auth-strategy magic_link --setup --yes
